paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: : Accuracy and reasoning chain length (# L) of on GSM8k dataset when trained with c{1,3,5,7} and tested with extra c{2,4,6} (under gray bars).

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between "Accuracy (%)" and "log(#L)" across varying values of "Compression Factor (c)". The plot features a linear x-axis labeled "Compression Factor (c)" with a range from 1 to 7, marked by tick labels at intervals of 1. Gray vertical shaded bars highlight the x-axis values of 2, 4, and 6. The plot utilizes dual linear y-axes. The primary y-axis on the left is labeled "Accuracy (%)" in purple text, ranging from below 10 to above 40 with tick labels at intervals of 10. The secondary y-axis on the right is labeled "log(#L)" in dark yellow text, ranging from below 1.5 to above 3.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. Two solid lines with circular markers traverse the plot. The purple solid line, corresponding to the left y-axis, begins at its highest point of approximately 44 at an x-value of 1. It drops to roughly 29.5 at x=2, rises to a local peak of about 34.5 at x=3, and then declines to 28.5 at x=4. After remaining relatively steady at roughly 29 at x=5, it drops to its lowest point of approximately 19 at x=6, before rising to end at roughly 26 at an x-value of 7. The dark yellow solid line, corresponding to the right y-axis, begins at its highest point of approximately 3.25 at an x-value of 1. It exhibits a continuous downward trend across the x-axis, dropping steeply to roughly 2.25 at x=2, and then declining more gradually through points at approximately 2.1 at x=3, 1.75 at x=4, 1.7 at x=5, and 1.55 at x=6, finally ending at its lowest point of approximately 1.4 at an x-value of 7.
model_annotations.German: This plot illustrates the relationship between a Compression Factor and two separate metrics, Accuracy and log(#L). The x-axis, labeled "Compression Factor (c)", uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7 with a tick label interval of 1, and features vertical light gray shaded bars highlighting the points x=2, x=4, and x=6. The plot contains two y-axes: the left y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" in purple, featuring a linear scale with values ranging from roughly 10 to 45 and a tick label interval of 10, while the right y-axis is labeled "log(#L)" in goldenrod, using a linear scale ranging from roughly 1.4 to 3.3 with a tick label interval of 0.5. A solid purple line with circular markers tracks the values for the left y-axis; it begins at a peak of approximately 44% at x=1, drops sharply to about 29% at x=2, rises to roughly 34% at x=3, and then fluctuates downward to a minimum of approximately 19% at x=6 before recovering to about 26% at x=7. A solid goldenrod line with circular markers tracks the values for the right y-axis; it exhibits a continuous, steady decline across the entire x-axis, starting at its highest value of roughly 3.25 at x=1, dropping steeply to about 2.25 at x=2, and continuing its downward trend to reach its lowest point of approximately 1.4 at the end of the x-axis at x=7.
